description: Non-KSB players who have faced KSB, enriched with the opposition player's team/division/rank for each season.

dataModel.players: Only non-KSB players who have appeared in KSB individual encounters.
dataModel.teamHistory: One record per season showing the opposition player's team, division and rank.
dataModel.ksbEncounters: Existing KSB-v-opponent individual matches, with opponent team attached where enriched.
dataModel.ksbByTeam: KSB player's record against each KSB team.
dataModel.oppositionTeams: Global team-level summaries derived from enriched individual encounters.
dataModel.note: Team-level statistics are derived from individual encounters, so they count only actual player matches, not team fixture scores.
